searchDocs.title: FlagPicker
searchDocs.content: FlagPicker Client LocalScript. Opens a searchable ScreenGui when OpenPicker fires, and submits RequestSetNation on selection. Escape / dimmer closes the UI.

searchDocs.title: FlagService
searchDocs.content: FlagService Server entry Script. Creates remotes, initializes FlagRegistry, hooks prompts, and handles RequestSetNation with FlagAuth checks. Remotes under ReplicatedStorage.NationFlagSystem.Remotes: OpenPicker (server → client): poleId, currentNationId RequestSetNation (client → server): poleId, nationId Notify (server → client): toast message

searchDocs.title: WorldFlags
searchDocs.content: WorldFlags ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 catalog of display names and Roblox image asset ids. Auto-generated from a LocalizationService countries flag dictionary. Each key is an ISO2 code mapping to { name: string, flagAssetId: number }.

searchDocs.title: Modes​
searchDocs.content: Mode	Allowed whenGroup	Player rank in GroupId ≥ MinGroupRank Team	player.Team.Name == TeamName Either	Group or Team passes Anyone	Always (useful for testing)  With default Either + GroupId = 0, only the Team check can succeed until you set a group id.

searchDocs.title: Flow​
searchDocs.content: Player triggers the pole ProximityPromptServer checks FlagAuth.isAuthorizedDenied → Notify toast with Config.DenyMessageAllowed → OpenPicker with poleIdClient selects a nation → RequestSetNationServer re-checks auth and applies TextureID

searchDocs.content: Set attributes on the pole Model:  Attribute	Type	DescriptionAuthMode	string	Same values as Config GroupId	number	0 falls back to Config MinGroupRank	number	Minimum group rank TeamName	string	Empty falls back to Config PoleId	string	Stable id (auto-assigned GUID) CurrentNation	string	Last applied nation id

searchDocs.title: Nations / textures​
searchDocs.content: WorldFlags — ISO2 → { name, flagAssetId } catalogPassportExtras — passport-system codes, ISO3→ISO2 map, overrides (e.g. UNO)Nations — merged API used by server and picker  Override a texture by editing PassportExtras.Overrides or the place-known entries inside Nations.

searchDocs.title: Writing API docs​
searchDocs.content: Use Moonwave tags in Luau sources:  --[=[ @class MyModule Short description. ]=] --[=[ Resolves something. @within MyModule @param name string @return boolean ]=] function MyModule.doThing(name: string): boolean   See the Moonwave docs.

searchDocs.title: From GitHub Releases (recommended)​
searchDocs.content: Open the latest release and download nation-flag-system.rbxm.In Studio, drag it into the viewport (or Insert from File).Move contents into your place:  From the release Folder	Move intoReplicatedStorage.NationFlagSystem	ReplicatedStorage ServerScriptService.NationFlagSystem	ServerScriptService StarterPlayerScripts.NationFlagSystem	StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts  Tagged releases (v*) build this model with rojo build release.project.json.

searchDocs.title: From source (Rojo)​
searchDocs.content: git clone https://github.com/metricrb/nation-flag-system.git cd nation-flag-system aftman install rojo serve default.project.json   Connect the Rojo plugin in Studio. Trees sync to:  Source	Studiosrc/ReplicatedStorage/NationFlagSystem	ReplicatedStorage.NationFlagSystem src/ServerScriptService/NationFlagSystem	ServerScriptService.NationFlagSystem src/StarterPlayerScripts/NationFlagSystem	StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.NationFlagSystem  Local release build:  rojo build release.project.json --output nation-flag-system.rbxm

searchDocs.title: Place requirements​
searchDocs.content: Flag poles live under Workspace.Flags (or change Config.FlagFolderPath).Each pole is a Model with a flag MeshPart (name containing flag preferred).Optional: tag extra poles with CollectionService tag CustomizableFlag.Edit Config for auth defaults.Create a Team named Staff (or change Config.TeamName) if using Team / Either mode.  FlagService starts automatically as a Script under ServerScriptService.NationFlagSystem.

searchDocs.title: What you get​
searchDocs.content: ProximityPrompts on each flag poleGroup and/or Team authorization (per pole or global)~250 world nations in a searchable pickerPassport-system asset nations sorted firstMeshPart TextureID swaps on your existing flag meshes
